name: 無底板頁首＋標誌左上、選單按鈕右下
desc: 固定的無底板頁首，只有畫面左上角的小標誌和畫面右下角的選單按鈕，導覽連結全部收進選單面板；捲動時兩者都留在原位。
prompt: 建立一個橫跨整個畫面寬的頁首列，固定在畫面頂端。頁首沒有底板，標誌與選單按鈕各自直接放在頁面上，疊在頁面內容上方。只有標誌和選單按鈕，導覽連結全部收進選單面板：標誌很小，放在畫面左上角，靠近畫面左緣與上緣，比頁面內容寬度更靠邊；選單按鈕不在頁首列裡，而是固定在畫面右下角、靠近畫面右緣與下緣，是內含圖示與短文字的橫長按鈕，約佔畫面寬的六分之一。選單按鈕左端可疊一個小插圖，略高出按鈕上緣，沒有時省略，其他元素的位置不變。捲動時標誌與選單按鈕都留在原位，不隱藏也不改變。點選單按鈕後打開選單面板，導覽連結收在面板裡。
mobile: 選單按鈕移到畫面底部並水平置中，寬度接近整個畫面寬，左右各留少量距離；按鈕左端的小插圖省略。捲動後畫面頂端不顯示標誌，只留畫面底部的選單按鈕。點選單按鈕後打開選單面板，導覽連結收在面板裡。

en.name: Bare header with logo top-left and menu button bottom-right
en.desc: A fixed header with no backing panel: only a small logo in the top-left corner of the viewport and a menu button in the bottom-right corner, with all navigation links inside the menu panel; both stay in place while scrolling.
en.prompt: Create a header bar spanning the full width of the viewport, fixed to the top of the viewport. The header has no backing panel; the logo and the menu button sit directly on the page, overlaying the page content. Place only the logo and a menu button, with all navigation links inside the menu panel: the logo is small and sits in the top-left corner of the viewport, close to the left and top edges, closer to the edge than the page content width; the menu button is not in the header bar but is fixed to the bottom-right corner of the viewport, close to the right and bottom edges, as a wide button containing an icon and short text, about one sixth of the viewport width. Optionally place a small illustration overlapping the left end of the menu button, rising slightly above its top edge; omit it when there is no content, without changing the position of the other elements. While scrolling, the logo and the menu button stay in place without hiding or changing. Clicking the menu button opens the menu panel, which holds the navigation links.
en.tablet: The tablet layout follows the mobile layout.
en.mobile: The menu button moves to the bottom of the viewport, centered horizontally and nearly the full viewport width, with a small margin on the left and right; the small illustration at the left end of the button is omitted. After scrolling, no logo is shown at the top of the viewport; only the menu button at the bottom remains. Tapping the menu button opens the menu panel, which holds the navigation links.
